lines.text: Many learners say: I am not good at speak English.
Better: I am not good at speaking English.
After good at, say speaking, not speak.
Cooking! I am not good at speaking English.

data.wrong: I am not good at speak English.
data.right: I am not good at speaking English.
data.why: After good at, say speaking, not speak.
data.memory: I am not good at speaking English.

native.hook: 「話すのが苦手」は good at speak？
native.tip: good at のあとの動詞は -ing 形にします。
native.caption: “I am not good at speak English.”と言っていませんか？😅 「話すのが苦手」の「話す」を、そのまま原形で置いてしまいがちです。“I am not good at speaking English.” が自然な言い方です。Carlosの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“cooking”。good at＋-ing で自分の文を1つ書いてみよう。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.caption: Do you say this? “I am not good at speak English.” 😅 After good at, use the -ing form. The natural way is “I am not good at speaking English.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
